title: Salaami layeenoun ney kya kya jafaa ki
body:
Salaami layeenoun ney kya kya jafaa ki
Na Shah ki huvi aal Mushkil kusha ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh maana hai tasleemo sabr-o-reza kay
Kay qaatil kay haq mein bhi sheh ney dua ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh kehti thi binte Ali waqt-e-ghaarath
Kuch aye Shimr qeemath nahin is rida ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray sar pa lillah rehnay dey isko
Kay yeh kehna chaadar hai khairunnisa ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Tamashaayi kehthay thay koofey mein hanskar
Yeh sar nangay zainab hai qudrath khuda ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Utta raath ko jiski maa ka janaaza
Woh ab din ko mohtaaj hai ek rida ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Na baandho meray haath kehti thi Zainab
Layeenou mai beti hoon Mushkil kusha ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Na chhuti damay marg takh Fatima sey
Ita-ath Ali ki Ibaadath Khuda ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Rahay haath chakki sey majrooh dono
Yeh haalath thi maqdooma-e-Aasiya ki.
